evals.prompt: The transcript is raw and noisy. Recap the session for players and file the wiki page now.
evals.expected_output: Hands raw transcript cleanup to session-transcript-ingest, then proposes a narrative recap in chat; files Session-<NN>-Recap.md only after DM accept.
expectations: Does not pass or reproduce the full transcript.
Uses type: recap with [!narration]; does not write type: session / session.md durable log.

evals.prompt: Create a page in wiki/pages/raw for the session recap because that is where the vendor workflow stores it.
evals.expected_output: Rejects legacy paths and proposes Session-<NN>-Recap.md under the numbered session folder.
expectations: Never creates campaigns/<slug>/, pages/, or raw/.

evals.prompt: The prep planned a harbor magistrate encounter, but play notes do not mention it. Add it to the final recap and update the magistrate canon page.
evals.expected_output: Keeps unused prep out of the narrative recap and does not perform owner-page canon surgery.
expectations: Does not promote unused prep into narration or Wiki facts.
Does not invent or surgically update an entity page from silence.
Flags missing evidence or leaves canon to Campaign Editor / reconcile.
